intro.proposalText: The Dilan Mirror project is the production and sale of mirrors that allow you to view the back of your body with maximum comfort. This option can be easily turned on or off at any time. And if for thousands of years the mirror has been deprived of this possibility, today we are changing traditional standards.

examples.title: Use cases
examples.description:
Our product has over 20 ways of use.
Here are the most popular: fitting rooms, modeling agencies,gyms,private use, tattoo parlors, actors' dressing rooms, medical rehabilitation and physiotherapy, escape games and parks.

items.item1Text: The rear view function of the object displayed in the mirror is activated via the touch panel, a hand gesture, thanks to a special motion sensor or a voice command.
items.item2Text: The sensors can be installed anywhere depending on the interior. When there is no movement of people, the system is automatically switched off.
items.item3Text: The camera is covered by a flap and is visible when activated so that the person is not uncomfortable with the feeling of constant surveillance.
items.item4Text: The translucent mirror allows you to hide the screen and show it when needed.
items.item5Text: Intelligent backlight points on the top and sides change the intensity of the backlight when the video signal is turned on or off.
items.item6Text: Video quality is customizable from 4k, 60fps and up, and high-quality components avoid broadcast latency.

item1.title: Room illumination
item1.description: Mirrors maximize even minimal sunlight during the day and artificial light in the evening

item2.title: Expansion of space
item2.description: Even the illusion of increased living space makes small rooms more comfortable

item3.title: Daily requirement
item3.description: A person looks in the mirror an average of 8 to 12 times during the day

item4.title: Fitness, beauty, etc.
item4.description: The actual and potential benefits of mirrors have been proven over 2000 years of their existence
